title: Skip LLM classification for duplicate files
description: In internal/cli/process.go, isDuplicate is computed during preprocessing but every duplicate still calls classifier.Classify. For duplicates that do NOT match cfg.SafeDeletePatterns, set a review decision before spawning the goroutine and skip the Ollama round-trip. Only classify duplicates when they may be promoted to delete by SafeDeletePatterns.

title: Check decision cache in preprocessing
description: In internal/cli/process.go, after computing fileHash call db.FindDecisionByHash(fileHash). If a cached decision exists, apply it directly without acquiring a worker semaphore or calling classifier.Classify. This removes per-file goroutine overhead for already-seen content and frees workers for files that actually need the model.

title: P2 Update CLI output and review for renames

acceptance_criteria: process output shows old -> new name or kept name; review command displays proposed rename; --dry-run previews renames without moving files.

title: Modernize Ollama client request handling
description: In internal/llm/llm.go: pass context.Context through Classify/requestChat/requestGenerate/postJSON, add configurable RequestTimeout to Config, replace map[string]any decoding with concrete response structs, make checkModel cache a map keyed by (url, model) instead of a single tuple, and split promptTemplate into system + user messages. NOTE: Ollama /api/chat request system messages override the Modelfile SYSTEM prompt, so any request-level system message must include the full classifier instructions or we must keep them in the Modelfile and only send a user message.
close_reason: Implemented prompt deduplication, context propagation, configurable request_timeout, concrete Ollama response structs, and per-(url,model) checkModel cache.
